We have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{OC} & =c=2i+4j-3k, \\ \overset{\to }{OD} & =d=-i+5k.\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overset{\to }{DC}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DC} & =\overset{\to }{OC}-\overset{\to }{OD} \\  & =c-d \\  & =(2i+4j-3k)-(-i+5k) \\  & =3i+4j-8k.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{DC}| & =\sqrt{{3}^{2}+{4}^{2}+(-8)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{9+16+64} \\  & =\sqrt{89}.\end{aligned}
$$
